findings.message: test_suggest_publishes_while_writer_lock_is_held starts a child process with subprocess.Popen to hold the writer lock. A unit test must not start a process, and this one also hand-copies the flock logic instead of using chupa's Lockfile.
findings.paved_road: Hold the lock in-process the way the existing tests do (e.g. tests/test_cli.py:383 and :597): `holder = Lockfile(root / ".chupa/state", instance_id="other", clock=Clock()); holder.acquire()`, run `cli(root, "suggest", ...)`, then release it in `finally`. flock is per open file, so suggest would still fail or block if it tried to take the lock.
